Level:

How the levels work

I Can (أنا أستطيع)
CVC words with pictures, 3 choices, a second try (half marks), 30 s per question. Reading starts at step 1.
Towards Mastery (نحو الإتقان)
Digraphs & blends, read-the-word, 4 choices, word order, 20 s. Reading starts at step 4.
I Am Distinguished (أنا متميز)
Syllables, opposites & categories, build words, grammar, 12 s + speed bonus. Reading starts at step 7.

Recommended level

80%+ → move up · 50–79% → stay · below 50% → move down (average of the last 3 rounds at the current level). Press Apply to change the student's level.

All rounds

📖 Reading Control Centre

Status uses the latest fluency accuracy and average comprehension (fluency steps 8–9 + story questions): Strong = 90%+ accuracy and 80%+ comprehension · Support = below 75% accuracy or below 50% comprehension. A fluency step passes with 90% accuracy (and the questions on steps 8–9) on 2 different days; pace is recorded for you but never blocks a pass. Words to practise = most frequently misread words.

📇 Flashcard words – proofread Arabic meanings & examples

Edit any meaning or example and press Save. Changes appear on the students' flashcards and travel with the class code to other devices.

1. Put your classes on other devices

Copy the class code here, open the platform on the other device → Teacher → Devices & backup → paste it under “Import”.

2. Collect results from other devices

On each student device, copy the results code and paste it here on your main device. Stars and reports are merged with no duplicates.
